title: HS30092: Demography
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: None Course ContentsIntroduction, Classical theories of
demography (modern population theories of fertility- socio-economic approach),
Fertility and its current pattern in India, reproductive motivation in
developing societies, Decision making of households, Family planning in
developing world, Health and mortality, Aging, Migration, Empirical analysis of
demography (e.g., Female education and fertility, female employment rate and
fertility, etc.), Demographic policies, Social and demographic change, Social
and Demographic inequality in developing countries, World population and India,
and Contemporary issues of Demography.
